news.contents: Dallas Cowboys quarterback Dak Prescott gets George Pickens (hamstring) back for Sunday's game against San Francisco. news.contents: Jacksonville Jaguars running back Chris Rodriguez Jr. has scored three of his four rushing touchdowns with the Jaguars already ahead by at least 18 points. Against Baltimore, Rodriguez was stopped for no gain from the one-yard line on Jacksonville's opening drive, and Bhayshul Tuten scored on the next play. news.contents: The Houston Texans have ruled out running back David Montgomery (groin) for Sunday's Week 10 game on the road against the Cleveland Browns due to an ongoing groin injury, according to Adam Schefter of ESPN. Montgomery returned to practice this week and is making progress, but the 29-year-old will end up missing a fourth straight game. His absence will be good news for Woody Marks, who will once again operate as Houston's primary running back this weekend, giving him RB2 upside against the ...

news.title: Josh Jacobs (finger) undergoes successful surgery

news.contents: Green Bay Packers running back Josh Jacobs (finger) underwent successful surgery on his fractured right ring finger on Friday and should be back "in the next few weeks," per Tom Pelissero of The Ringer. Jacobs is out for Green Bay's Week 10 matchup against the Minnesota Vikings on Sunday, but the Packers have their bye in Week 11. Based on the given timeline, Jacobs could have a chance to return in Week 12 against the Los Angeles Rams and will almost certainly be back by Week 13 against the New ...
